playback_worker_rule: workers may request repository-generated decoded-media evidence and accept evidence for their own active claimed playback task; workers must not modify the evidence service implementation or its generated evidence/audit outputs
notes: An Agent is admin only when the authenticated GitHub login is verified as witnessGIT or the repository owner explicitly grants an admin exception in the current interaction.
github-actions[bot] is a system actor allowed to publish validated Playback Evidence Service outputs.
If account identity cannot be verified, act as worker.

Worker Agents may modify business-task outputs that belong to a valid claimed task, plus their own coordination claim/completion/readiness records, playback requests/acceptances, and new immutable bug reports.

Playback requests and acceptances are worker business coordination records. data/playback_evidence and data/playback_audits are generated/validated service outputs and are not direct worker-write surfaces.
The GitHub Actions service, scripts, schemas and workflow definitions remain admin-only.
Worker Agents must not patch scripts, schema, CI, task orchestration, workflow policy, or other control-plane files when they encounter a bug.
Bugs are fixed by admin Agents operating under the witnessGIT management account.
